SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL INSPECTION OBSERVATIONS

Form FDA 483 - Inspectional Observations (fictional summary)
Firm: Ardent Sterile Manufacturing, Plant 2
Product Types: Sterile injectable small-volume parenterals
Inspection Dates: July 7-15, 2026

Observation 1: Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile were not established and followed; smoke studies of the ISO 5 filling line did not demonstrate unidirectional airflow during aseptic interventions.
Observation 2: Environmental monitoring excursions in Grade A areas (7 occurrences over 6 months) were not adequately investigated and no root cause was identified.
Observation 3: Media fill simulations did not include worst-case interventions performed during routine production.
Observation 4: Batch records lacked documentation of line clearance for 3 of 20 batches reviewed.
The firm is expected to provide a written response describing corrective and preventive actions within 15 business days.

key_requirements: Repeat smoke studies demonstrating unidirectional airflow on ISO 5 line
Investigate Grade A environmental monitoring excursions with root cause
Include worst-case interventions in media fills
Document line clearance in all batch records
Submit written CAPA response within 15 business days
safety_signals: Sterility assurance deficiencies in aseptic processing
output.summary: Four-observation FDA 483 at a sterile injectables plant citing aseptic processing, environmental monitoring, media fill, and documentation gaps; CAPA response due in 15 business days.
